353:             CombinerState::Reading(_) => true, // see reader_state_valid instead

365:                 // the current index is between local tails and tail.
366:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] <= cur_idx <= tail
367:                 // the read tail is smaller or equal to the current tail.
368:                 &&& tail <= self.tail

398:             require(forall |i: int| #[trigger] contents.contains_key(i) ==> stored_type_inv(contents[i], i, cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, buffer_size) as int], unbounded_log_instance));
399:             init contents = contents;
400: 
401:             init alive_bits = Map::new(Set::range(0, buffer_size), |i: nat| !log_entry_alive_value(i as int, buffer_size));
402:             init combiner = Map::new(Set::range(0, num_replicas), |i: NodeId| CombinerState::Idle);
403:         }

407:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
408:     // Reader Transitions
409:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
410:     //
411:     // The reader transitions traverse the log and read the entries in it.
412:     //
413: 
414:     /// start the reader on the provided node, the combiner must be in idle state.
415:     transition!{
416:         reader_start(node_id: NodeId) {
417:             have   local_versions    >= [ node_id => let local_head ];
418: 
419:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
420:             add    combiner += [
421:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Starting { start: local_head })
422:             ];
423:         }
424:     }
425: 
426:     /// enter the reading phase
427:     transition!{
428:         reader_enter(node_id: NodeId) {
429:             remove combiner -= [
430:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Starting { start })
431:             ];
432:             add combiner += [
433:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range { start, end: pre.tail, cur: start })
434:             ];
435:             assert start <= pre.tail;
436:         }
437:     }
438: 
439:     /// read the value of the current entry to process it
440:     transition!{
441:         reader_guard(node_id: NodeId) {
442:             remove combiner -= [
443:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur })
444:             ];
445: 
446:             require(cur < end);
447: 
448:             have alive_bits >= [ log_entry_idx(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) => log_entry_alive_value(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) ];
449: 
450:             birds_eye let val = pre.contents.index(cur as int);
451: 
452:             add combiner += [
453:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
454:             ];
455: 
456:             // assert(stored_type_inv(val, cur as int));
457:         }
458:     }
459: 
460:     /// the value of the log must not change while we're processing it
461:     property!{
462:         guard_guards(node_id: NodeId) {
463:             have combiner >= [
464:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
465:             ];
466:             guard contents >= [ cur as int => val ];
467: 
468:             assert(stored_type_inv(val, cur as int, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) as int],  pre.unbounded_log_instance));
469:         }
470:     }
471: 
472:     /// finish processing the entry, increase current pointer
473:     transition!{
474:         reader_unguard(node_id: NodeId) {
475:             remove combiner -= [
476:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
477:             ];
478:             add combiner += [
479:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur: cur + 1 })
480:             ];
481:         }
482:     }
483: 
484:     /// finish the reading whith, place the combiner into the idle state
485:     transition!{
486:         reader_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
487:             remove combiner -= [
488:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur })
489:             ];
490:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
491: 
492:             remove local_versions -= [ node_id => let _ ];
493:             add    local_versions += [ node_id => end ];
494: 
495:             require(cur == end);
496:         }
497:     }
498: 
499:     /// abort reading, place the combiner back into the idle state
500:     transition!{
501:         reader_abort(node_id: NodeId) {
502:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(r) ];
503:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
504: 
505:             require(r.is_Starting() || r.is_Range());
506:         }
507:     }

510:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
511:     // Advance Head Transitions
512:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
513:     //
514:     // The advance head transitions update the global head of the log with the minimum value
515:     // of all local heads.
516: 
517:     /// start the advancing of the head by reading the local head of node 0
518:     transition!{
519:         advance_head_start(node_id: NodeId) {
520:             have   local_versions >= [ 0 => let local_head_0 ];
521:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
522:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx: 1, min_local_version: local_head_0,} ];
523:         }
524:     }
525: 
526:     /// read the next local head
527:     transition!{
528:         advance_head_next(node_id: NodeId) {
529:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx, min_local_version } ];
530: 
531:             have   local_versions    >= [ idx => let local_head_at_idx ];
532:             require(idx < pre.num_replicas);
533: 
534:             let new_min = min(min_local_version, local_head_at_idx);
535:             add combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx: idx + 1, min_local_version: new_min } ];
536:         }
537:     }
538: 
539:     /// update the head value with the current collected miniumu
540:     transition!{
541:         advance_head_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
542:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx, min_local_version } ];
543:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
544:             update head      = min_local_version;
545: 
546:             require(idx == pre.num_replicas);
547:         }
548:     }
549: 
550:     /// stop the advancing head transition without uppdating the head
551:     transition!{
552:         advance_head_abort(node_id: NodeId) {
553:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { .. } ];
554:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
555:         }
556:     }

559:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
560:     // Advance Tail Transitions
561:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
562:     //
563:     // The advance tail transition bump the tail of the log to make space for new entries.
564:     // We first read the current head as this defines the maximum value the tail can be advanced to
565:     // as we need to ensure that we do not overrun existing entries.
566: 
567:     /// start the advancing of the head tail by reading the head value
568:     transition!{
569:         advance_tail_start(node_id: NodeId) {
570:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
571:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingTail { observed_head: pre.head } ];
572:         }
573:     }
574: 
575:     /// advance the tail to the new value
576:     transition!{
577:         advance_tail_finish(node_id: NodeId, new_tail: nat) {
578:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingTail { observed_head } ];
579:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx: pre.tail, tail: new_tail } ];
580:             update tail      = new_tail;
581: 
582:             // only allow advances and must not overwrite still active entries
583:             require(pre.tail <= new_tail <= observed_head + pre.buffer_size);
584: 
585:             // construct the entries in the log we withdraw
586:             birds_eye let withdrawn = Map::new(
587:                 Set::range(pre.tail - pre.buffer_size, new_tail - pre.buffer_size),
588:                 |i: int| pre.contents[i],
589:             );
590: 
591:             withdraw contents -= (withdrawn) by {
592:                 assert forall |i: int| pre.tail - pre.buffer_size <= i < new_tail - pre.buffer_size implies pre.contents.contains_key(i) by {
593:                     let min_local_head = map_min_value(pre.local_versions, (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
594:                     map_min_value_smallest(pre.local_versions,  (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
595:                 }
596:             };
597: 
598:             assert forall
599:               |i: int| pre.tail - pre.buffer_size <= i < new_tail - pre.buffer_size
600:                 ==> stored_type_inv(#[trigger] withdrawn[i], i, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, pre.buffer_size) as int], pre.unbounded_log_instance) by {
601: 
602:                 assert forall
603:                   |i: int| pre.tail - pre.buffer_size <= i < new_tail - pre.buffer_size
604:                     implies stored_type_inv(#[trigger] withdrawn[i], i, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, pre.buffer_size) as int], pre.unbounded_log_instance) by {
605:                         assert(pre.contents.contains_key(i) && #[trigger] withdrawn.contains_key(i)) by {
606:                             let min_local_head = map_min_value(pre.local_versions, (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
607:                             map_min_value_smallest(pre.local_versions,  (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
608:                         };
609:                     };
610:                 };
611:         }
612:     }
613: 
614:     /// aborts the advancing tail transitions
615:     transition!{
616:         advance_tail_abort(node_id: NodeId) {
617:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingTail { .. } ];
618:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
619:         }
620:     }

628:     transition!{
629:         append_flip_bit(node_id: NodeId, deposited: StoredType<DT>) {
630:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx, tail } ];
631:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx: cur_idx + 1, tail } ];
632: 
633:             remove alive_bits -= [ log_entry_idx(cur_idx as int, pre.buffer_size) => let bit ];

637:             require(stored_type_inv(deposited, cur_idx as int, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(cur_idx as int, pre.buffer_size) as int],  pre.unbounded_log_instance));

639:             deposit contents += [ cur_idx as int => deposited ] by {
640:                 map_min_value_smallest(pre.local_versions,  (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);

642:         }
643:     }

645:     /// finish the appending parts

648:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx, tail } ];
649:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
650: 
651:             require(cur_idx == tail);
652:         }
653:     }

687:     #[inductive(append_flip_bit)]
688:     fn append_flip_bit_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, node_id: NodeId, deposited: StoredType<DT>) { 
689:         // Since this is an inductive proof for append_flip_bit transition, we know that
690:         // pre.combiner[node_id] must be CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx, tail} for some cur_idx, tail
691:         // and that cur_idx < tail (from the transition's require clause).
692:         
693:         match pre.combiner[node_id] {
694:             CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx, tail} => {
695:                 // For ranges_no_overlap invariant:
696:                 // We need to show that for all i,j where i != j:
697:                 // post.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(post.combiner[j])
698:                 
699:                 assert forall |i, j| post.combiner.contains_key(i) && post.combiner.contains_key(j) && i != j implies
700:                     post.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(post.combiner[j]) by {
701:                     
702:                     // Case 1: Neither i nor j is node_id - nothing changed for these combinators
703:                     if i != node_id && j != node_id {
704:                         assert(pre.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(pre.combiner[j])); // by pre invariant
705:                         assert(post.combiner[i] === pre.combiner[i]);
706:                         assert(post.combiner[j] === pre.combiner[j]);
707:                     }
708:                     // Case 2: One of them is node_id
709:                     else if i == node_id && j != node_id {
710:                         // post.combiner[i] = CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx + 1, tail}
711:                         // post.combiner[j] = pre.combiner[j] (unchanged)
712:                         
713:                         // Since pre satisfies the invariant, we know:
714:                         // pre.all_combiner_valid() holds, which means:
715:                         // forall |k| pre.combiner.contains_key(k) ==> pre.combiner_valid(k, pre.combiner[k])
716:                         // In particular, pre.combiner_valid(node_id, pre.combiner[node_id]) holds.
717:                         // And pre.combiner_valid(node_id, CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx, tail}) means:
718:                         // pre.combiner[node_id].no_overlap_with(pre.combiner[j]) holds.
719:                         
720:                         // We need to show:
721:                         // post.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(post.combiner[j])
722:                         // Which means: CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx + 1, tail}.no_overlap_with(pre.combiner[j])
723:                         
724:                         // By the pre invariant (all_combiner_valid), we have:
725:                         // pre.combiner[node_id].no_overlap_with(pre.combiner[j])
726:                         // Which means: CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx, tail}.no_overlap_with(pre.combiner[j])
727:                         
728:                         match pre.combiner[j] {
729:                             CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Guard{start, end, cur, val}) => {
730:                                 // For Appending{cur_idx, tail} vs Reading(Guard{..., cur, ...}):
731:                                 // Condition is: (cur_idx > cur) || (tail <= cur)
732:                                 // For Appending{cur_idx + 1, tail} vs Reading(Guard{..., cur, ...}):
733:                                 // Condition is: (cur_idx + 1 > cur) || (tail <= cur)
734:                                 
735:                                 // By pre invariant, we have: (cur_idx > cur) || (tail <= cur)
736:                                 // Need to show: (cur_idx + 1 > cur) || (tail <= cur)
737:                                 // If (tail <= cur), we're done.
738:                                 // Otherwise, (cur_idx > cur), so (cur_idx + 1 > cur).
739:                             },
740:                             CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx: cur_idx2, tail: tail2} => {
741:                                 // For Appending{cur_idx, tail} vs Appending{cur_idx2, tail2}:
742:                                 // Condition is: (cur_idx >= tail2) || (tail <= cur_idx2)
743:                                 // For Appending{cur_idx + 1, tail} vs Appending{cur_idx2, tail2}:
744:                                 // Condition is: (cur_idx + 1 >= tail2) || (tail <= cur_idx2)
745:                                 
746:                                 // By pre invariant, we have: (cur_idx >= tail2) || (tail <= cur_idx2)
747:                                 // Need to show: (cur_idx + 1 >= tail2) || (tail <= cur_idx2)
748:                                 // If (tail <= cur_idx2), we're done.
749:                                 // Otherwise, (cur_idx >= tail2), so (cur_idx + 1 >= tail2).
750:                             },
751:                             _ => {
752:                                 // For all other cases, no_overlap_with returns true
753:                             }
754:                         }
755:                     } else if i != node_id && j == node_id {
756:                         // post.combiner[i] = pre.combiner[i] (unchanged)
757:                         // post.combiner[j] = CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx + 1, tail}
758:                         
759:                         // By the pre invariant (all_combiner_valid), we have:
760:                         // pre.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(pre.combiner[node_id])
761:                         // Which means: pre.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx, tail})
762:                         
763:                         // We need to show:
764:                         // post.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(post.combiner[j])
765:                         // Which means: pre.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx + 1, tail})
766:                         
767:                         match pre.combiner[i] {
768:                             CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Guard{start, end, cur, val}) => {
769:                                 // For Reading(Guard{..., cur, ...}) vs Appending{cur_idx, tail}:
770:                                 // Condition is: (cur_idx > cur) || (tail <= cur)
771:                                 // For Reading(Guard{..., cur, ...}) vs Appending{cur_idx + 1, tail}:
772:                                 // Condition is: (cur_idx + 1 > cur) || (tail <= cur)
773:                                 
774:                                 // By pre invariant, we have: (cur_idx > cur) || (tail <= cur)
775:                                 // Need to show: (cur_idx + 1 > cur) || (tail <= cur)
776:                                 // If (tail <= cur), we're done.
777:                                 // Otherwise, (cur_idx > cur), so (cur_idx + 1 > cur).
778:                             },
779:                             CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx: cur_idx2, tail: tail2} => {
780:                                 // For Appending{cur_idx2, tail2} vs Appending{cur_idx, tail}:
781:                                 // Condition is: (cur_idx2 >= tail) || (tail2 <= cur_idx)
782:                                 // For Appending{cur_idx2, tail2} vs Appending{cur_idx + 1, tail}:
783:                                 // Condition is: (cur_idx2 >= tail) || (tail2 <= cur_idx + 1)
784:                                 
785:                                 // By pre invariant, we have: (cur_idx2 >= tail) || (tail2 <= cur_idx)
786:                                 // Need to show: (cur_idx2 >= tail) || (tail2 <= cur_idx + 1)
787:                                 // If (cur_idx2 >= tail), we're done.
788:                                 // Otherwise, (tail2 <= cur_idx), so (tail2 <= cur_idx + 1).
789:                             },
790:                             _ => {
791:                                 // For all other cases, no_overlap_with returns true

793:                         }
794:                     }
795:                 }
796:                 
797:                 // For upcoming_bits_are_not_alive invariant:
798:                 // We need to show that for all i where post.tail <= i < min_local_head + post.buffer_size:
799:                 // !log_entry_is_alive(post.alive_bits, i, post.buffer_size)
800:                 
801:                 let min_local_head = map_min_value(post.local_versions, (post.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
802:                 assert forall |i| post.tail <= i < min_local_head + post.buffer_size implies 
803:                     !log_entry_is_alive(post.alive_bits, i, post.buffer_size) by {
804:                     // This proof is complex and requires detailed reasoning about the buffer wraparound properties.

809:                 // For inv_buffer_contents invariant:
810:                 // Need to show:
811:                 // 1. forall |i: int| post.tail - post.buffer_size <= i < post.tail ==> (

813:                 //          i < map_min_value(post.local_versions, (post.num_replicas - 1) as nat))
814:                 //      <==>
815:                 //      #[trigger] post.contents.contains_key(i)
816:                 //    )

820:                     ((log_entry_is_alive(post.alive_bits, i, post.buffer_size) ||
821:                         i < map_min_value(post.local_versions, (post.num_replicas - 1) as nat))

826:                     // 2. post.buffer_size == pre.buffer_size
827:                     // 3. post.local_versions == pre.local_versions
828:                     // 4. post.contents == pre.contents.insert(cur_idx as int, deposited)
829:                     // 5. cur_idx < pre.tail
830:                     
831:                     assert(post.contents.contains_key(i) == (pre.contents.contains_key(i) || i == cur_idx as int));
832:                     
833:                     if i == cur_idx as int {
834:                         // We added this entry, so post.contents.contains_key(i) is true
835:                         // We need to show that:
836:                         // (log_entry_is_alive(post.alive_bits, i, post.buffer_size) ||
837:                         //   i < map_min_value(post.local_versions, (post.num_replicas - 1) as nat))
838:                         // is also true
839:                         
840:                         // Since we just made this entry alive (that's the whole point of the transition),
841:                         // log_entry_is_alive(post.alive_bits, i, post.buffer_size) should be true.
842:                         // In the transition, we set:
843:                         // alive_bits[log_entry_idx(cur_idx as int, pre.buffer_size)] = log_entry_alive_value(cur_idx as int, pre.buffer_size)
844:                         // So log_entry_is_alive(post.alive_bits, cur_idx as int, post.buffer_size) is true by definition.
845:                         assert(log_entry_is_alive(post.alive_bits, i, post.buffer_size));
846:                     } else {
847:                         // post.contents.contains_key(i) == pre.contents.contains_key(i)
848:                         // By pre invariant, we have:
849:                         // (log_entry_is_alive(pre.alive_bits, i, pre.buffer_size) ||
850:                         //   i < map_min_value(pre.local_versions, (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat))
851:                         // <==> pre.contents.contains_key(i)
852:                         //
853:                         // We need to show:
854:                         // (log_entry_is_alive(post.alive_bits, i, post.buffer_size) ||
855:                         //   i < map_min_value(post.local_versions, (post.num_replicas - 1) as nat))
856:                         // <==> post.contents.contains_key(i)
857:                         //
858:                         // Since post.local_versions == pre.local_versions, we just need to check the alive_bits part.
